summary: Investigated Gizmo's extension packaging to find how shared runtime modules are exposed to extensions, then installed @json-render/core and @json-render/svelte pinned to exact version 0.20.0 (plus zod@4.4.3 as a peer) as dependencies of @gizmo/app, preparing to expose them through the existing host-modules mechanism so extensions can use them without bundling their own copies.
decisions: Pin @json-render/core and @json-render/svelte to exact version 0.20.0 (via pnpm --save-exact) so extensions can rely on a stable API surface.

Reuse Gizmo's existing host-modules sharing mechanism (apps/app/src/lib/extensions/runtime/host-modules.ts) to expose json-render to runtime-loaded web extensions, rather than letting extensions bundle their own copies.
Add zod@4.4.3 alongside because @json-render/svelte declares zod ^4.0.0 as a peer dependency.
